info.name: CineReserva API
info.description: Run the folders in order (Collection Runner works too). Tokens and ids are stored in collection variables by the test scripts. Requires the seed: `pnpm seed` locally or `docker compose exec api node dist/seed/seed.js`.

item.name: 2FA

request.description: Scan qrCodeDataUrl (paste it in the browser address bar) with Google Authenticator, or add the secret manually.

exec: // RFC 6238 TOTP (SHA1, 6 digits, 30s) computed from the secret saved by 'Generate 2FA secret'.
for (let i = 0; i + 8 <= bits.length; i += 8) keyHex += parseInt(bits.substr(i, 8), 2).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');

item.description: The folder pre-request script computes {{totp}} from the stored secret, so the whole flow runs unattended. To use a real phone instead, scan qrCodeDataUrl and type the code.
